definitions.explanation: The direction opposite to north, where the sun is at midday in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {南口|みなみぐち}から{出|で}てください。
examples.english: Please exit from the south exit.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{南|みなみ}に{大|おお}きい{公園|こうえん}があります。
examples.english: There's a big park south of the station.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{南|みなみ}にある{島|しま}は{冬|ふゆ}でも{暖|あたた}かいので、{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: The islands in the south of Japan are warm even in winter, so I want to travel there.

notes:
{南|みなみ} is one of the four cardinal directions.

FOUR DIRECTIONS:
- {東|ひがし}: east
- {西|にし}: west
- {南|みなみ}: south
- {北|きた}: north

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {南口|みなみぐち}: south exit (at stations)
- {南側|みなみがわ}: south side
- {南向|みなみむ}き: facing south
- {南風|みなみかぜ}: south wind

PLACE NAMES:
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ: South America
- {南極|なんきょく}: Antarctica (South Pole)
- {東南|とうなん}アジア: Southeast Asia

CULTURAL NOTE:
South-facing ({南向|みなみむ}き) rooms are preferred in Japan for good sunlight, making them more desirable in housing.
